meta.title: CHUNK VST3 — Multiband Channel Strip | Assembly DSP
meta.description: CHUNK is a Windows VST3 multiband channel strip from Assembly DSP. EQ, compressor, and spectral RS on one graph. $39 launch price. 30-day free trial.

hero.lede: A multiband channel processor — Preamp, EQ, Multiband Compressor, Multiband Resonance Suppressor, Stereo Widener, Clipper.

product.headline: Starting at the top, we made a channel strip.
product.lede: CHUNK puts the tools you reach for across a channel into one place. Input preamp with saturation, 180 degree variable phase rotation, EQ, multi-band compressor, resonance control, stereo widener, and brick wall limiter / clipper.

layers.headline: One graph. Three ways to shape it.
layers.eqHeadline: Eight bands, built to move fast.
layers.eqBody: Bell, shelves, high and low pass, and plateau filters. Drag a node where you want it, shape the curve, or solo a band to hear exactly what you're working on.
layers.eqAlt: CHUNK EQ window — multiband equalizer with spectrum graph and band controls
layers.compHeadline: Six-band dynamics with per-band sidechain and gate.
layers.compBody: Threshold, ratio, attack, release, knee, range, and makeup are set independently for each band, with a gate and sidechain, which can be set, per band, to external, or internal, including other bands.
layers.compAlt: CHUNK COMP window — multiband compressor with transfer curve and dynamics controls
layers.rsHeadline: Find unwanted resonances. Pull them back.
layers.rsBody: Create up to four regions and RS splits each one into around 80 narrow bands. Those bands react independently, pulling down resonances as they appear without turning down the whole region.
layers.rsAlt: CHUNK RS window — resonance suppressor with spectral gain reduction

extras.headline: A few more things built in.
extras.item1: Saturation at the input and output, with even/odd harmonic control
extras.item2: Stereo width and continuous phase control
extras.item5: VST3 for Windows. macOS AU coming later.
extras.inAlt: CHUNK input page — level, harmonics, gain, and phase
extras.outAlt: CHUNK output page — level, brickwall limiter, width, and harmonics

compare.headline: The channel strip grew up.
compare.lede: Traditional strips give you EQ, compression, and a gate. CHUNK keeps that one-window workflow and adds multiband, spectral, and resonance tools — without assembling a chain.
compare.noteDeess: CHUNK de-essing is via a high COMP band or an RS region, not a dedicated de-esser module.
compare.noteFabMb: FabFilter Mixing Bundle includes Saturn 2 (multiband saturation) and Pro-Q 4, but not Pro-MB.
compare.noteFabRs: Pro-Q 4 Spectral Dynamics can treat varying problem frequencies. It is not a dedicated automatic resonance-suppression module.
compare.notePrice: Prices are manufacturer regular / MSRP. Sale prices vary; Waves regularly discounts Scheps Omni Channel 2.
compare.closeLine: One plugin. One window. The whole channel.
compare.closeLede: Everything you need to shape a channel without building a plugin chain.

pricing.headline: Launch pricing.
pricing.lede: Full license, 30-day free trial — no commitment while you put it on real sessions.
pricing.note: Launch offer · Regular price $79 · 30-day free trial
